measured.note: Task 7: how the render is compared with the painting for the shape numbers. head.halfWidth and head.top are CONFIG ranges (the authored dome); the rest is like for like on the picture.
measured.segmentation: G>=95 and G-R>=40 and B>=0.7G, or R>150 and G>150; rows 196-427 (title and nameplate out); bubble r17 at (432, 392) out; 3x3 close, largest component, holes filled. On P2 itself it gives IoU 0.992 with p2-mask.png on rows 196-427. Run: python scripts/veyra_shape.py <capture.png>.

visibleHalfWidth.reason: The config halfWidth (0.88) is the dome before the rim fades and the halo widens it; the visible dome half-width is measured the same way on both pictures at four heights and held to 0.03 world units (3 px at the native panel, the painting edge soft over about 3 px).

armSpan.reason: The 3.75 floor is the painting measured with its halo glow, which widens the reach by about 0.03 to 0.05; the render is segmented the same way and held to 0.05 of the painting.

iouExcluding.reason: The painting shows nine or ten arms; Veyra has eight (spec 2.5). The two boxes hold the extra hanging arms (between T5 and T6, and behind T3); the iou target is met with them left out of both masks.

nearHer.reason: Task 11: in the vault world the recipe also takes the world's green plants and seagrass beside her arm tips (span 3.94, IoU 0.850 at Task 10). The held numbers are taken on the recipe's pixels within 4 px (0.04 units) of the engine's silhouette: P2's segmented span is 0.04 over the engine's (3.75 against 3.71), so 4 px keeps her halo as the recipe sees it and leaves the world beyond it out. The targets are unchanged.
